question.text: Investee-level DD for Cat III AIFs focuses on:

answer.text: Financial and business due diligence to understand investment risks, with stewardship monitoring of financial performance, operational risk, strategy and governance

explanation.text: The Logic: Investee-level due diligence centres on financial and business due diligence to understand investment risks. Governance, financial performance, operational risk and strategy fall under stewardship monitoring of investee companies. The Trap: Narrow scopes such as sector-only research, promoter KYC or share price miss the financial/business DD focus and the stewardship lens used post-investment. Note: Keep the investee-DD template focused on financial and business risks, with governance and operating performance tracked through stewardship.
